Method of Attack: Uses 26 exploits to propagate, mostly targeting unpatched IoT devices
Exploits include command execution vulnerabilities in networked devices
Includes exploits for Oracle WebLogic Server and VMware SD-WAN
Attack code derived from Mirai malware
Discoverer: Larry Cashdollar of Akamai's Security Intelligence Response Team (SIRT)
Indicators of Compromise: Command and control servers at domains akumaiotsolutions.pw and akuma.pw (do not resolve to IP addresses)
